quest.title: Start Spreadin' the News
quest.description: Help Thoma advertise his housekeeping course to attract more people to come.

talks.objective: Gather 1 serving of Lavender Melon, Fowl, and Flour each
Give the housekeeping course materials you collected to Thoma
Advertise the housekeeping course to the city merchants
Advertise the housekeeping course to the city housewives
Advertise the housekeeping course to the city's senior folk
Return to the Yashiro Commission to make final preparations

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: I don't think we've got enough...

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: I'll need <color=#00E1FFFF>Lavender Melon</color>, <color=#00E1FFFF>Fowl</color>, and <color=#00E1FFFF>Flour</color>. Thanks again in advance.

talks.objective: Go to the Yashiro Commission to take part in the housekeeping course

dialogues.speaker: Nagano
dialogues.text: If you are as good as you claim to be, I will encourage everyone I know to attend your classes. And if I find your skills to be lacking, I will be quite happy to teach a few things myself.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: What can I say — we'll be honored to have you in attendance, Sir.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: #Well then... that will probably just about do it as far as promotion is concerned. Let's head back to the Yashiro Commission, {NICKNAME}.
